clauses.clause: Axe rack ring visible from the game camera (not behind sign/bollard); axe optional (`no-axe` run finishes).
clauses.note: All12 current-source WebGL2/WebGPU low/high actualzoom0.5/1/1.5 opening frames personally inspected. Yellow axe ring is readable on the paving below the freestanding sign and to the near side of the apron bollards. Corgi/pack overlap part of its right edge; high-tier grass partly overlaps the left edge, but sign and bollards do not hide the ring. Both exact-source native no-axe fixtures complete without axe ownership. These optional-weapon fixtures suppress incoming damage and establish absence of an axe prerequisite, not mortal survival difficulty.
